criteria.requirement: The response body is valid JSON and contains the top-level fields endpoint, result, provenance, summary and meta.
result.totalTax equals result.federalTax plus result.stateTax plus result.ficaTotal, to the cent.
result.ficaTotal equals result.socialSecurity plus result.medicare plus result.additionalMedicare, to the cent.
result.netAnnual equals result.inputs.salary minus result.totalTax, to the cent.
result.netPerCheck equals result.netAnnual divided by result.periodsPerYear, rounded to two decimals.
